description: Fetches earthquake data from USGS FDSN API - query events, count results, and  retrieve event details with parsed GeoJSON responses.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - query: Query earthquake events with filters (time, magnitude, location); 参数: starttime, endtime, orderby, eventtype, alertlevel, minmagnitude, maxmagnitude, mindepth, maxdepth, minlatitude, maxlatitude, minlongitude, maxlongitude, latitude, longitude, maxradiuskm, minradiuskm, limit, offset, minfelt, minsig; 必填: 无
  - count: Count matching events without returning full data; 参数: starttime, endtime, orderby, eventtype, alertlevel, minmagnitude, maxmagnitude, mindepth, maxdepth, minlatitude, maxlatitude, minlongitude, maxlongitude, latitude, longitude, maxradiuskm, minradiuskm, limit, offset, minfelt, minsig; 必填: 无
  - detail: Get detailed information for a specific event by ID; 参数: eventid; 必填: eventid

starttime.description:
Start time for search (ISO-8601 format). Used by query and count.
Example: "2025-09-01T00:00:00"

endtime.description:
End time for search (ISO-8601 format). Used by query and count.
Example: "2025-09-30T23:59:59"

orderby.description:
Sort order for results. Used by query.
Options: "time" (default), "time-asc", "magnitude", "magnitude-asc"

eventtype.description:
Filter by event type. Used by query and count.
Options: "earthquake", "quarry blast", "explosion", etc.

alertlevel.description:
Filter by PAGER alert level. Used by query and count.
Options: "green", "yellow", "orange", "red"

minmagnitude.description:
Minimum magnitude filter. Used by query and count.
Example: 5.0

maxmagnitude.description:
Maximum magnitude filter. Used by query and count.
Example: 9.0

mindepth.description: Minimum depth in kilometers. Used by query and count.

maxdepth.description: Maximum depth in kilometers. Used by query and count.

minlatitude.description:
Minimum latitude for bounding box search (-90 to 90).
Used by query and count.

maxlatitude.description:
Maximum latitude for bounding box search (-90 to 90).
Used by query and count.

minlongitude.description:
Minimum longitude for bounding box search (-180 to 180).
Used by query and count.

maxlongitude.description:
Maximum longitude for bounding box search (-180 to 180).
Used by query and count.

latitude.description: Center latitude for circular search. Used by query and count.

longitude.description: Center longitude for circular search. Used by query and count.

maxradiuskm.description:
Maximum radius in kilometers from center point.
Used by query and count.

minradiuskm.description:
Minimum radius in kilometers from center point.
Used by query and count.

limit.description:
Maximum number of results to return (1-20000). Used by query.
Default is unlimited (returns all matching events).

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Used by query.

minfelt.description: Minimum number of felt reports. Used by query and count.

minsig.description: Minimum significance (0-1000). Used by query and count.

eventid.description:
USGS event ID for retrieving specific event details.
Required for detail function. Example: "us6000rdta"
